monster.name: Asteroid Spider
senses: blindsight 120 ft. while the spider's eyes are closed

trait.name: Fausse apparence
entries: Si  spider is motionless, has its eyes and mouth closed, and has its legs wrapped around its body at the start of combat, it avantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if une créature hasn't observed the spider move or act, that creature doit réussir on a {@dd 18}Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the spider is anything other than an asteroid.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Si  spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The spider doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two Web Strand attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}21 ({@dégât 3d8 + 8}) piercingdgts plus 10 ({@dégât 3d6}) aciddgts.

action.name: Web Strand
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 13} pour toucher, allonge 120 m,, une créature. {@h}The target is {@condition agrippé} (escape {@dd 18}). The web strand can be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; 20touché points; vulnerability to firedgts; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychicdgts). The spider can grapple up to six creatures at a time using its web strands.

action.name: Reel
entries: The spider pulls each creature {@condition agrippé} by it up to 60 mètres straight toward itself.

bonus.name: Snare Ship (1/Day)
entries: The spider weaves a magical web around a spelljamming ship it can see within 120 feet of itself. The web lasts for 1 minute and suppresses the magic of any spelljamming helm aboard the ship. Decks and other surfaces of the ship that aren't enclosed become difficult terrain until the effect ends. The web is impervious to damage but is destroyed by a successful casting of {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 18}).

trait.name: Shutdown
entries: If targeted by {@spell dispel magic}, the horror doit réussir on ajet de sauvegarde Constitution against the caster's spell save DD or fall {@condition inconscient} for 1 minute or until it takes anydgts.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The horror doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes one Bite attack and two Rotating Saw attacks, or it makes two Lightning Jolt attacks.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d8 + 2}) piercingdgts.

action.name: Rotating Saw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}4 ({@dégât 1d4 + 2}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Lightning Jolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} pour toucher, portée 120 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d10 + 2}) lightningdgts.

action.name: Spelljamming Helm Interface
entries: The horror attaches to a spelljamming helm it can see within 5 mètres of itself and attunes to the helm instantly. If another creature is already attuned to the helm, that creature's attunement to the helm ends lorsque the horror's attunement begins. The horror can operate the helm even though it isn't a spellcaster. The horror can detach from the helm as a bonus action, which ends its attunement to the helm.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Far Realm Parasite
entries: Inside the lich's torso dwells a wormlike parasite that contains the lich's soul. When the lich dies, it implodes into the parasite, which then vanishes into the Far Realm. In {@dice 2d4} days, the parasite causes the lich to reappear within {@dice 1d4} kilomètres of where it died. Si  lich died inside a magic circle cast to contain Undead, the lich instead reappears as an {@creature otyugh} with all the lich's memories.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: Si  lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The lich doesn't need air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich makes one Parasitic Tentacle attack or uses Spellcasting. The lich also uses Psychic Whisper twice.

action.name: Parasitic Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une créature. {@h}25 ({@dégât 6d6 + 4}) piercingdgts plus 25 ({@dégât 6d6 + 4}) necroticdgts. The target doit réussir on a {@dd 17}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or be {@condition empoisonné}. The {@condition empoisonné} target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The third time la cible fails the save, la cible dies and dissolves into a {@creature gibbering mouther} that obeys the lich and uses la cible's initiative.

action.name: Psychic Whisper
entries: The lich targets une créature it can see within 120 mètres of itself. The target doit réussir on a {@dd 17}Sagesse saving throw or take 25 ({@dégât 6d6 + 4}) psychicdgts and be {@condition étourdi} until the end of the lich's next turn as incomprehensible whispers fill la cible's mind.

reaction.name: Far Realm Step
entries: Immediately after taking damage, the lich, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: The fractine avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Scrying Focus
entries: A spellcaster can use the fractine as a substitute focus lorsque casting the {@spell scrying} spell or similar magic, provided the spellcaster and the fractine are within 5 mètres of each other.

trait.name: Two-Dimensionality
entries: The fractine can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. It can move through other creatures and objects comme si they were difficult terrain, but it takes 5 ({@dégât 1d10}) forcedgts if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The fractine doesn't require air, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Extradimensional Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}24 ({@dégât 8d6}) forcedgts.

bonus.name: Imprison
entries: The fractine targets one creature of its size or smaller in its space. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be imprisoned in a demiplane. While the creature is imprisoned, a distorted image of it can be seen on the fractine's two-dimensional surface.

The demiplane moves with the fractine, has indestructible and opaque walls, and is only as big as it needs to be to contain the target, which doesn't suffer from hunger or thirst while imprisoned. No other creature can enter the demiplane, and the fractine can't be harmed from within the demiplane.

The fractine can imprison only one creature at a time and can release that creature as a bonus action. If the fractine is reduced to 0 hit points, any creature in the fractine's demiplane is released instantly. A released creature reappears in an unoccupied space as close to the fractine (or where it died) as possible. A creature can leave the demiplane on its own by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the {@spell plane shift} spell.

reaction.name: Mirrored Damage
entries: In response to being damaged by a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself, the fractine forces that creature to make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 ({@damage 8d6}) force damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a Large fractine that has at least 10 hit points remaining takes bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, or thunder damage from any source, it splits into two Medium fractines. The new fractines occupy the space formerly occupied by the original fractine, and each new fractine has hit points equal to half the original's, rounded down. If the original fractine had a creature trapped in its demiplane, that creature is released when the fractine splits, reappearing in an unoccupied space as close to the new fractines as possible.

trait.name: Air Envelope
entries: If it has at least 1touché point, the gadabout can generate an air envelope around itself lorsque in a vacuum. This air envelope can sustain the gadabout and one other creature in its space indefinitely.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The gadabout doesn't require food or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gadabout makes two Branch attacks.

action.name: Branch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}3 ({@dégât 1d4 + 1}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Wrap
entries: The gadabout enters the space of a willing Medium or Small creature within 5 mètres of itself and gently wraps its branches around la cible. The target is {@condition agrippé} (escape {@dd 0}). Any attempt by la cible to escape the grapple causes the gadabout to use its reaction to move into the nearest unoccupied space. While {@condition agrippé} by the gadabout, la cible determines where the gadabout moves on the gadabout's turns and accompanies the gadabout wherever it goes.

trait.name: Burst
entries: The goon balloon bursts lorsque it drops to 0touché points, releasing noxious gas in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Creatures in that area doit réussir on a {@dd 12}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or be {@condition empoisonné} for 1 minute. A {@condition empoisonné} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The goon balloon doesn't require air, food, or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goon balloon makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Griffe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}3 ({@dégât 1d6}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Scintillating Eye
entries: Magical, kaleidoscopic light emanates from one of the goon balloon's eyes as the goon balloon targets une créature it can see within 30 mètres of itself. The target doit faire a {@dd 12}Sagesse saving throw, taking 6 ({@dégât 1d12}) psychicdgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.

bonus.name: Float
entries: The goon balloon moves up to 20 feet vertically in one direction without provoking opportunity attacks. If it ends this movement suspended in the air, it hovers in place. It can't be knocked {@condition prone} while airborne.

monster.name: Nightmare Beast
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: Si  beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Monstre de siège
entries: The beast deals doubledgts to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The beast makes two Claw attacks and one Tusk attack.

action.name: Griffe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} pour toucher, allonge 15 m,, une cible. {@h}14 ({@dégât 1d12 + 8}) slashingdgts, and if la cible is une créature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 21}Force saving throw or be knocked {@condition à terre}.

action.name: Tusk
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} pour toucher, allonge 15 m,, une cible. {@h}17 ({@dégât 2d8 + 8}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Disintegration Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: The beast targets une créature it can see within 60 mètres of itself. The target doit faire a {@dd 18}jet de sauvegarde Constitution, taking 70 ({@dégât 10d6 + 40}) forcedgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one. If this magical effect reduces la cible to 0touché points, la cible is disintegrated and leaves nothing behind, except a pile of ashes plus whatever equipment it was wearing or carrying.

bonus.name: Teleport (2/Day)
entries: The beast magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Tusk Attack
entries: The beast makes one Tusk attack.

legendary.name: Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The beast moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes two Tusk attacks.

legendary.name: Frightful Howl (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The beast howls as it exhales a cloud of magical fear gas in a 120-foot cone. Any creature in that area doit réussir on a {@dd 18}Sagesse saving throw or be {@condition effrayé} of the beast for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The parasite doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Cling
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une créature. {@h}12 ({@dégât 3d6 + 2}) necroticdgts, and the parasite attaches to la cible. While attached, the parasite can't make Cling attacks. The parasite can detach itself by spending 5 mètres of its movement. As an action, une créature within allonge of the parasite can try to detach it, doing so with a successful {@dd 14}Force check.

action.name: Consume Life
entries: The parasite deals 12 ({@dégât 3d6 + 2}) necroticdgts to une créature it is physically attached to, provided that creature isn't a Construct or an Undead. The parasite regainstouché points equal to thedgts taken.

bonus.name: Suggestion (Psionics; 1/Day)
entries: The parasite casts the {@spell suggestion} spell, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}).

trait.name: Vol en piqué
entries: The star lancer doesn't provoke opportunity attacks lorsque it flies out of an enemy's allonge.

action.name: Cornes
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d6 + 4}) piercingdgts. Si  star lancer moved at least 20 mètres straight toward la cible immediately before thetouché, la cible takes an extra 10 ({@dégât 3d6}) piercingdgts.

action.name: Invisibility Cloak (3/Day)
entries: The star lancer and une créature riding it (chosen by the star lancer) magically turn {@condition invisible}. This effect lasts until the star lancer or une créature riding it attacks or casts a spell, or until the star lancer's {@status concentration} ends (comme si {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment worn or carried by the {@condition invisible} creatures is also {@condition invisible} for the duration of the Invisibility Cloak.

trait.name: Cavities
entries: The yggdrasti has {@dice 1d4 + 2} cavities in its trunk. Each cavity is big enough to hold one Medium creature, two Small creatures, or eight Tiny creatures. A creature inside a cavity has {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} against attacks and other effects that originate outside the cavity. The yggdrasti's cavities aren't connected to one another.

trait.name: Fausse apparence
entries: Si  yggdrasti is motionless and rooted in the ground at the start of combat, it looks just like a dead tree and avantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if une créature hasn't observed the rooted yggdrasti move or act, that creature doit réussir on a {@dd 18}Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the yggdrasti is animate.

trait.name: Lightning Conduit
entries: Si  yggdrasti is subjected to lightningdgts, it is unhurt, and the lightningdgts is instead divided evenly among all creatures it is grappling. In addition, the yggdrasti regains one use of Lightning Discharge.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The yggdrasti doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yggdrasti makes two Root attacks and uses Lightning Discharge (if available).

action.name: Root
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 20 m,, une cible. {@h}12 ({@dégât 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoningdgts, and if la cible is une créature, it is {@condition agrippé} (escape {@dd 15}). The yggdrasti has four roots, each of which can grapple une cible.

action.name: Lightning Discharge (3/Day)
entries: The yggdrasti shoots lightning at une créature within 120 mètres of itself. The target doit faire a {@dd 13}Dextérité saving throw, taking 31 ({@dégât 7d8}) lightningdgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.
